name: usage-credits
description: Your usage credits (the pool Fable draws on) above the prompt: dollars left of the monthly limit and percent used, refreshed from your account every few minutes, with a warning toast as it runs low.

pollMinutes.title: Refresh every (minutes)
pollMinutes.description: How often to ask the account for the credit balance; it is also refreshed after each turn, at most once a minute

warnAt.title: Warn at (percent used)
warnAt.description: A toast when usage crosses this percent, and again at 95
